authority_decision_detail: All required task authorities accepted the bound request.
reason: Pump-A completed maintenance and has been provisionally returned to run-in-service, but its run-in restriction (restriction-a-run-in-001) remains active and it is not yet assured for outage planning. The service schedule requires 2 SCU from 18:00 today, and pump-C alone supplies only 1 SCU. Completing the P1 post-maintenance verification now — while the verification engineer and all field resources are free — is the shortest path to assuring pump-A in time for the 18:00 demand uplift. The backlog item is due by 18:00 (calendar second 64,800) and by pump-A's 9-hour runtime limit, both of which converge on the same deadline.
